old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a steaming hot pot filled with a variety of ingredients, including mushrooms, enoki mushrooms, leafy greens, and possibly tofu or other vegetables. The hot pot is divided into two sections, each containing different types of food. Steam rises from the pot, indicating it is freshly cooked and ready to be eaten. In the background, there are white cups on the table, suggesting a dining setting. Skewers with food items are lowered into the pot. The scene is set in what appears to be a casual dining environment, with the focus primarily on the hot pot and the act of lowering food on skewers into it. The video emphasizes the communal and interactive nature of the meal, highlighting the shared experience of enjoying food together.

caption: The video captures a close, eye-level view of a two-compartment metal hot pot filled with dark simmering broth and an assortment of ingredients, including shiitake, oyster and enoki mushrooms, bean sprouts, and green leafy vegetables. A white cup sits on the left and a white plate on the right, with a person in pink and black clothing behind the pot. A bamboo skewer threaded with puffed fried-tofu pieces and a red-and-white crab stick moves downward from the top edge of the frame into the left compartment. The skewered items settle at the rim, the wooden sticks protruding upward as they rest just inside the broth. Wisps of steam grow more visible, drifting upward over the left compartment as the segment progresses. The pot, its contents, and the background objects remain fixed in position, with no clear camera pan or zoom. The descent of the skewer is object motion rather than a change in viewpoint. The broth continues to simmer beneath the resting skewered pieces, steam rising steadily from the surface.
